title: Digital Skills Training for Women
description: Introductory digital skills training for women interested in improving employability.
eligibility_note: Suitable for women with basic computer skills who want to improve digital skills.

title: Remote Work Readiness Program
description: Training designed to prepare participants for remote work and online professional opportunities.
eligibility_note: Suitable for users with basic computer knowledge and interest in remote work.

title: Women Entrepreneurship Support Program
description: Basic entrepreneurship guidance for women interested in starting a small business.
eligibility_note: Suitable for women interested in business learning and entrepreneurship skills.

title: Financial Literacy Program for Women
description: Basic guidance about budgeting, saving, financial planning and formal financial services.
eligibility_note: Suitable for beginners who want to improve their financial knowledge.

title: Online Tutoring Readiness Program
description: Preparation pathway for individuals interested in providing online academic support.
eligibility_note: Suitable for users who have subject knowledge and interest in online tutoring.
